summary: The proof establishes both stated generic bounds with the original affine probabilities. The disjoint reflected-pair halfspace estimate, ordered-pair grouping identity, scalar and Holder inequalities, and two-case constants are correct. The zero-midpoint and lower-affine-rank cases are covered. The ternary midpoint classifications and support counts give the claimed corollaries; the application uses exactly the support of accepted fact 49bba4c121c43db7, and its support properties are independent of the field. The maps to the predecessor probabilities, depths, and scalar inputs are explicit and preserve normalization. Smallest supports, empty midpoint sets, missing Boolean points, and arbitrary field coefficients reveal no counterexample or gap.
